text: Beg pardon? Did you say something?
The PHOENIX MUSEUM! Tonight, a solitary light burns within its secluded walls...
...for here, the museum board is about to open a mummy case from far away, mysterious, old EGYPT!
I discovered this mummy case a year ago. But because of the war, there was a delay in shipping. Legend states this case is full of gold and jewels!
Or perhaps it is.. er.. ACCURSED, eh? Heh heh!
The chilling thought of a CURSE has arisen...
ACCURSED! Er— who will open it?
I'll open it. I'm not afraid. Heh, heh!
PROFESSOR AMES, you discovered the case—it is your privilege to look in first...
Er... I will extend you that honor, WILSON... along with me. C-come on!
???? No mummy! No jewels!
Just an old piece of papyrus!
It says... "A curse of death on all who disturb the tomb of SHAD-RU-KHEL! BEWARE!"
A CURSE! Just as you predicted, Wilson!
But pshaw! This is a practical joke! There's been a mistake in shipment. I'm going to Africa and bring back the REAL Shad-ru-Khel case. Good night, gentlemen!
Gentlemen, I protest against Ames's rash decision! It's DANGEROUS to defy this curse! I move that he should be forced to stay!
Sorry, Wilson. There's NOTHING we can do about it. Ames is president of the board, you know.
Professor Ames wearily makes his way home, to find waiting for him DOTTIE TENGALLON, famed girl columnist.
DOTTIE TENGALLON! What a pleasant surprise! I know your father, JIMMY TENGALLON, well!
Hullo, Prof! Say, what's the news on this mummy case? I need an item for my syndicated column!
The mummy case was empty! Big disappointment. All we found was a worthless note that said something about a CURSE. Just a prank, I'm sure!
CURSE! Prank? Br-r-r it gives me goose-pimples!
Then I don't suppose you'd care to go to Africa with me, Dottie... after the real mummy case?
What? Africa? GO WITH YOU?
YIPPEE! A trip to Africa! I'll say I'll go! Just wait'll I tell BILLY BATSON about this!
Just like her father, Jimmy, lots of spirit. A fine girl.
Better yet! I'll PHONE Billy... this is news that can't wait!
Why hello, Dottie! What's cooking? Where are you calling from?
I'm in a booth at Fourth and Main. But listen, Billy. I've just been talking with Professor Ames, and guess what? I'M GOING TO AFRICA WITH HIM! We're going to search for—
Dottie is excited. Too excited to notice a bandaged hand that creeps from the shadows... a MUMMY'S HAND!
...to search for the REAL mummy... ugh gulp! (click)!
OOH!
Dottie's in trouble! I'm hurrying down to Fourth and Main to look into this, Miss Dalshaw!
SHAZAM!
BILLY BATSON says the magic word—
Here I go to Fourth and Main at—FULL SPEED AHEAD!
—and in a flash he becomes the WORLD'S MIGHTIEST MORTAL—CAPTAIN MARVEL!
Brief seconds pass, as with the speed of light itself, CAPTAIN MARVEL zooms to his destination.
Where Dottie called from!
But suddenly, as he nears the spot, he sees...
For the love of mud!... A MUMMY!
Hold on there, bud!
Is it Captain Marvel? You may get me, O wonder of wonders, BUT THE GIRL DIES!
Ha, ha, ha! The curse of Shad-ru-Khel—strikes!
(Gulp)! I can't let Dottie fall!
Got her!
The mummy escaped, but Dottie's okay, so... SHAZAM!
BILLY! But I thought a mummy...
I'll take you home now, Dottie. We'd both better get some sleep. WE'VE GOT TO MAKE A TRIP TOMORROW!
Did you say "WE," Billy? You're going too?
Yes.. er.. for the adventure!
But really because I think that mummy will show up again! And when he does..
Next day, the party meets at the dock in preparation for the trip... a dark trail to the DARK CONTINENT.
Ames, old man—I implore you not to go! Think of the terrible curse!
NOTHING will stop me, Wilson. I'm going...
Well... then I'm going too, Ames! I'll... er... take my chances with the curse!
Good, Wilson! Glad you're coming with us!
Far out to sea...
Ahh! A deck chair! You kids run along and play. I'm going to take it easy!
See you later, Professor Ames!
I'm sea sick! I'm going to my cabin!
WHAT'S THIS!??? Two piercing eyes glare from a port hole, and a clutching mummy's hand glides forth toward Professor Ames!
Such a lovely trip. And no mummy to worry about!
Oh well, guess I'll take a short stroll around deck after all.
You got away by accident, Ames! But next time I won't fail! The curse of Shad-ru-Khel will fall on ALL OF YOU! YOU WILL NEVER REACH THE SACRED PYRAMID!
Professor Ames idly strolls into the churning engine room.
Fascinating! Machinery is almost as interesting as mummies...
This time you will NOT escape, Professor Ames!
But on the other side of the machinery Billy and Dottie arrive....
Now that piston, Dottie... HEY!
UGG! HELP!
Why that sounds like the Professor!
The curse of Shad-ru-Khel is upon you, foolish one!
The mummy! SHAZAM!
Let's you and me get chummy, MUMMY!
AWK! I lost my balance! I'M FALLING!
Into the very jaws of the rumbling, crunching machinery dives Captain Marvel! Something has to give way... and it isn't Marvel!
The only way to save the Professor is to STOP THE MACHINERY!
Whew! I-I'm confused! What all happened?
That mummy threw you into the engines! Luckily Captain Marvel saved you.—But the mummy escaped again!
SHAZAM!
The mummy's murderous trail is lost. They search every inch of the VESSEL—WITHOUT RESULTS...
No, not a sign of the mummy, anywhere! I haven't seen this mummy!—er—are you SURE you didn't IMAGINE it?
Professor Ames and I couldn't BOTH have imagined our narrow escapes, Professor Wilson! HMMFF!
At last, days later, their boat drops anchor at an Egyptian port....
British soldiers! Hmm—I'd almost forgotten this is a theater of war!
We're not concerned with that Billy... only with the scientific aspects of the mummy mystery!
There's the CAMEL HOTEL! I suggest we stay there overnight.
Good idea, Wilson.
You sure go for—er—large head-gear, Dottie!
Well, Billy, after you get used to wearing a ten-gallon hat, everything else seems trivial. Like it?
Very—er—lovely, Dottie. But I'm going to drop in on Professor Ames for a minute!
I keep thinking we're being watched! I wish Captain Marvel had caught that mummy.
EEEEK! HELP!
Listen! A scream!
The scream has come from Dottie's room, where....
Ha ha ha! The curse has struck again! I will get the others through this girl! Ha ha!
DOTTIE! She's gone! Do you suppose the mummy...??
That's my guess too. So—
SHAZAM!
CAPTAIN MARVEL! Are we glad to see you!
Someone else is going to see me soon too—A MUMMY!
Meanwhile, the mummy has raced through winding streets, and reaches an ancient stone building....
??? CURSES! Here comes that flying wonder again! But I'll foil him!
Just try and break through THAT door, my friend!
EARTH'S MIGHTIEST MORTAL smashes through the massive door as though it were made of flimsy paper, not solid iron!
There he goes, down that sewer!
I dare him to pull THIS up—I JUST DARE HIM!
Test number two, eh? Well, here goes—WOOPS!
Hurriedly, the MIGHTY MARVEL digs his fingers into the stone and—
THAT'S BETTER!
Several tunnels! Which one did the mummy—??
You are strong—
O mighty mortal!
But you can't be—in two places at once—
And these echoes—
Have you bewildered!
Looks like that confounded mummy HAS got me stumped! I can't go chasing through ALL these tunnels... HEY! What's that on the floor?
A lipstick message from Dottie! Hmm—"Tomorrow" eh? Sure is a lucky thing that girl knows the CAPTAIN MARVEL CODE!
For only the privileged members of the famed CAPTAIN MARVEL CLUB can decipher—or write—this kind of code.
Later, back at the hotel—
Wilson is gone too, Billy. I'm afraid he was murdered first by the mummy. And what about poor Dottie—?
Easy, Professor Ames, I just had a tip from Captain Marvel. He says Dottie is safe for the time being—and that we're to follow your map tomorrow.
Next day, and the search party sets out.
According to my map, that pyramid is the tomb of Shad-ru-Khel!
Go slowly, effendi! It is ACCURSED!
Meanwhile, deep within the hoary, old pyramid where the mummy has arrived through his underground passages...
So! Professor Ames and Billy Batson still dare the CURSE! The fools! I'll show them!
Now I know the truth! You're a Nazi agent, Mummy! And this treasure is the stolen wealth of Shad-ru-Khel!
JA!
Of course, my dear, and now my men will go out and scare the daylights out of your friends! Hurry, men!
Back, brainless ones! Back—or the curse falls upon you!
Gulp!
Gulp! SHAZAM!
Captain Marvel!
Stay here, Professor—while I rip this place wide open!
HIMMEL!
Don't run, fools! ATTACK! In the name of Shad-ru-Khel—ATTACK!
Such horrible faces! I'm SO frightened!
But what's underneath the disguises is even more horrible—NAZIS!
Yes, Captain Marvel! The mummy is a Nazi agent! He planned to turn the stolen treasure of Shad-ru-Khel over to Hitler!
Tie those Nazis up, Dottie—and watch that treasure! I'm going after Herr Mummy! I think I know who he is!
Deeper into the pyramid's winding mazes, Marvel pursues the mummy!
Ha ha—! This stone door is TEN FEET THICK!
So what?
What's this—?—Hmm, I get it all now! A secret Nazi supply base, BACK OF THE BRITISH LINES! Hidden in an innocent pyramid!
RIGHT! And the curse of Shad-ru-Khel was to keep meddlers like you and Ames away!
Take that you—
Get ready to fly—WILSON!
Propelled by Marvel's mighty blow, the mummy, now revealed as Wilson, flies back—but his broken sword strikes a spark, igniting a tin of gasoline!
AAAAAGH!
FIRE! When it reaches the gun powder—! I've got to save Dottie and Ames! IN THE SHORTEST POSSIBLE TIME!
Right through solid stone cleaves mighty Captain Marvel.... to where he left Dottie...
CAPTAIN MARVEL! WHA—!
Brace yourselves! I'm going to grab you two up!
—And out we go!
Just in time! The pyramid blew to smithereens!
And that's the end of a Nazi secret base! Now back to our ship—and America!
Out at sea—and heading home!
So Wilson was the mummy all the time—a secret Nazi agent! But I'm disappointed! NO REAL MUMMY! NO TREASURE! Not even a REAL curse!
No REAL curse? Wasn't Wilson the first to molest the mummy case? AND DIDN'T HE DIE? That's curse enough!
One more surprise!
No treasure? What do you mean? I didn't bring this BIG HELMET along for nothing!
HOLY MOLEY!
See CAPTAIN MARVEL every month in WHIZ COMICS!
